prs.author: minglong51

clusters.pick_reason: #2214 only changes the trailing-slash stripping regex (single slash -> `/\/+$/`) in buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls, but leaves shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check as `pathname === '/'` — since stripping now turns '/' into '', that check silently stops matching and root-like paths would retrigger redundant fallback discovery attempts. #2215 makes the same trailing-slash fix via a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper AND updates shouldAttemptFallback to check `pathname === ''`, keeping the root-detection logic consistent with the new normalization output. #2215 is the more complete fix and avoids the latent inconsistency #2214 would leave behind.
